name: TizenAmbilight
description: Real-frame ambilight: reads the TV's own video plane in memory and drives a WLED strip over UDP. While a streaming app's DRM withholds the plane, falls back to the TV's built-in RGB measurement (coarser and slower). Headless background service (.tpk); no Hyperion/HyperHDR needed.

fields.label: Number of LEDs on the strip (max 490)
Where the strip's first LED sits: LEDs counted clockwise from the screen's top-left corner, seen from the front (0 = it starts at the top-left corner)
Does the strip run counter-clockwise, seen from the front? 0 = no (clockwise), 1 = yes

Optional. Only used while the picture is DRM-protected (e.g. a streaming app): how many spots round the screen edge are measured. 24 is a good default; fewer = each spot updates faster but the colour is coarser (4-73). Leave the default if unsure
